name: Shimmerweed
summary: On Shimmer Ridge, Frostmane trolls gather shimmerweed for their rituals. Dwarven brewmaster Rejold Barleybrew wants to test its sharp flavor in his stout.

sections.title: A Trollish Crop
sections.body: The Frostmane trolls tend shimmerweed on the icy crags of Shimmer Ridge, high above Dun Morogh's lowlands. They harvest the plant and store it in woven baskets throughout their camps, where it fuels their sacred rituals. Few mountaineers beyond troll society pay the herb much mind, though inventive outsiders have taken an interest.

sections.title: A Secret Ingredient
sections.body: In Brewnall Village, brewmaster Rejold Barleybrew suspects shimmerweed may be the missing piece in his attempt to brew the ultimate dwarven stout. He has detected the herb's pungent, unmistakable flavor and wants to see what it brings to his fermenting vats. Rejold hires travelers to slip into Frostmane camps, evade the hostile trolls, and bring back bushels.

faq.answer: Shimmerweed grows on Shimmer Ridge, an icy rise northwest of Brewnall Village in Dun Morogh. The Frostmane trolls tend it and store what they gather in baskets around their camps.

faq.q: What do the Frostmane trolls use shimmerweed for?
faq.answer: The Frostmane trolls use shimmerweed in their mysterious tribal rites and ceremonies. Outsiders do not know the precise details, but the herb has a place in their cultural and spiritual practices on Shimmer Ridge.

faq.q: Why does Rejold Barleybrew want shimmerweed?
faq.answer: Rejold Barleybrew wants shimmerweed for his attempt to brew the perfect dwarven stout in Brewnall Village. He has detected its unique taste and hopes fresh bushels will give his experimental mash the bold profile his recipe needs.

faq.q: Does shimmerweed grow anywhere outside Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Shimmerweed has also been gathered in arid lands like Durotar, where farseers such as Drek'Thar value it for potent herbal concoctions and medicinal brews. The plant grows beyond the frozen peaks of Khaz Modan.

angles.text: Dwarven ingenuity can turn a strange plant from a nearby cliffside into an experiment in brewing.
For herbalists, shimmerweed shows how regional plants find uses in local brewing traditions and ritual alchemy.
